<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex10012024-10-0915-20-12">gnyis pa la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs> na re dmigs pa dang rnaM pa mi brda'<!--TOCHECK brda'? unclear--> pa 'di dag kyang rjes thob kyis bsdus pa yin par 'thad de | mnyaM par bzhag pa'i tshe ni <expan>thams cad</expan> du chos kyi dbyings kyi rnaM
            <lb n="69a3"/> pa can nyid do || 'on kyang rjes kyis mtshon nas 'di ltar bshad par zad do zhes zer ro || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4189">lha rje</rs> na re chos kyi °°° dbyings kyi che ba dang | thabs la mkhas pa'i che ba gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas yin te | dang po'i dbang du byas nas nges 'byed <expan>thams cad</expan> kyang dmigs pa mi rtag pa <expan>la sogs</expan> pa la rnaM pa °°° mngon par zhen pa <expan>la sogs</expan> pa bkag pa'i chos nyid kyis dmigs par byed pas yin pas dmigs rnaM la khyad med do ||
            <lb n="69a4"/> gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas <expan>sems can</expan> mos pa sna tshogs pa rnaMs kyi mos pa dang bstun nas de 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pas dmigs rnaM du mar gsungs pa yin no zhes zer ro | </seg></TEI>
